biography: Jarkko stands as a towering and vibrant figure within the illustrious chronicles of the Hector Trophée, having lent his exceptional golfing prowess from the immaculate fairways of Hirsala Golf to the esteemed pair competition across ten distinct editions. Affectionately known among his companions by the spirited moniker Bailando, this charismatic competitor possesses a relentlessly joyful personality that transforms every round into a celebratory affair, occasionally breaking into spontaneous dance steps right on the putting greens whenever a particularly challenging birdie putt finds the bottom of the cup.

Beyond his lively demeanor on the links, Jarkko has etched his name permanently into the tournament's record books through remarkable competitive triumphs. He has tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on one occasion, while also capturing the prestigious Victor Trophy for individual brilliance once during his storied career. As he remains fully active within the vibrant community surrounding the event, observers eagerly anticipate his next return, knowing well that Bailando will unfailingly deliver a masterclass in both high-level execution and unforgettable theatrical flair.
